episode_design.tape_hash: sha256 agps-step3r-tracking-tape-v1 over public controls, anonymous echoes and offline supervision
episode_design.bootstrap: 1000 paired resamples of whole tapes, stratified by training source, seed=root_seed

interpretation.association: Known role masks bypass search only. Present design roles use public echo coordinates and the Full sensor model; missing role/reused-role exact groups abstain as a whole. A mixed ghost/lumen echo is scored against its lumen centroid; no ghost component is injected.
interpretation.pose: Replace q_hat and its covariance, not probe, echoes or height selection. This jointly changes tracker mean and uncertainty; it is not a pullback ablation.
interpretation.geometry: Filtered (not smoothed) role-center errors for every rendered role/frame including every merge contributor. World SSE equals lateral/depth image SSE plus elevation SSE. Conditional RMSE is on finite readouts; complete RMSE is null if any fixed opportunity is missing or the tape is empty.
interpretation.identity: Exact-set membership F1 (not v6 single-label F1); all rendered echo contributors or NULL enter fixed truth denominators. Decision-conditional F1 excludes abstained echoes. Forced F1 measures intervention coverage, not identity correctness achieved by the reader.
interpretation.same_tape_criteria: Integer numerators over all tapes, fixed across arms. No rendered lumen means geometric criteria do not pass. Exact matches on forced masks are injected references; the joint diagnostic is not a continuation or certification measure.
interpretation.search: Known groups with all design roles and no reuse are structurally representable. Gate-admissible applies the production merge contact cutoffs before bounded association search; local top-k precedes proposal cap/dedup and branch pruning. A full true prefix must match all previous frames, including empty frames.
interpretation.limitations: Contrasts are descriptive train-source diagnostics, not guaranteed isolated effects: changes in associations and pose alter the subsequent filter state. Compare paired errors with coverage and search counts; conditional RMSE alone can improve by abstaining.
